# Security Policy

Do not report exploitable vulnerabilities in public issues. Until a private security contact is configured, use GitHub private vulnerability reporting for this repository.

Never include real credentials, wallet material, account identifiers, balances, production payloads, or unredacted logs in a report. Preserve evidence and describe the affected commit, boundary, reproduction conditions, and potential impact.

Live trading, withdrawals, arbitrary signing, and secret transport through ordinary environment variables are prohibited. A security fix is incomplete without regression tests, changelog entry, threat-model impact, and credential-rotation guidance where relevant.
